rulings.question: Q1 STU-VEC-023 says effects are carried in the shared StudioEffectStack and STU-VEC-022 forbids a vector-only reimplementation; the slice adds a separate stack in vector records.
rulings.ruling: Accept the object-scope stack in StudioVectorRecords as the first step, AND make each entry the spec's StudioLiveFilter shape (STU-FX-002 field names, see Q3), so that unification later moves records rather than reshaping them. Record an SD item: STU-VEC-023 object scope partly met; holder placement open.
rulings.reason: READ: the folio StudioEffectStack (folio/src/raster.rs:740-746) is {effect_stack_id, enabled, scale, effects: Vec<StudioEffect>} and StudioEffect (raster.rs:714-733) is a layer-style instance with blend, opacity, noise, angle and a StudioEffectKind enum, not a StudioLiveFilter with filter_kind; prepare_vectors takes no raster records (scope, composite/src/vector.rs:2025, composite unchanged). Putting path effects there would mean a second shape inside the 'shared' type. Two partial stacks already sit outside it (smart filters, envelope).
rulings.red_team: Strongest objection: STU-VEC-023 is a MUST, and accord already declares the shared schema hsk.studio.effect_stack@1 (accord/src/lib.rs:19); a third stack makes the eventual merge a migration of stored documents. Stands because the merge is a migration either way (the existing raster stack's shape is not the spec's StudioLiveFilter either), the new member is additive and absent when empty, and using the spec's entry fields keeps the later move a container change. Ruling unchanged.

rulings.question: Q2 STU-VEC-157 gives default 1.0 for scale (percent) and move; copied literally a fresh transform makes 1 percent copies 1 unit away; nib's identity defaults are 100 and 0; MT-30558 AC-001 demands the table values.
rulings.ruling: Default stands: nib's 100 percent and 0, labelled a Studio reading in the descriptor with the spec cell quoted verbatim beside it; commands store resolved entries; SD item; MT-30558 stays open.
rulings.reason: READ spec :4355-4360: scale default 1.0 with unit percent and soft range 0..200, move default 1.0 document_unit. A 1 percent default scale is not an identity, and STU-VEC-157 says transform-each and the live effect share one parameter set; an identity default is what transform-each needs. Storing resolved entries (EffectRecord::entries, nib live_effect.rs:642, unchanged) means a later spec fix cannot silently change stored documents.
rulings.red_team: Strongest objection: STU-FX-107 and STU-VEC-100 forbid substituting a value the source did not give, and MT-30558's AC is literal. Stands: the alternative ships a broken default into every stored record; the divergence is visible (verbatim cell in the descriptor, SD item) rather than silent, and no MT row is claimed. Ruling unchanged.

rulings.question: Q3 Type and member names: StudioLiveFilter from the spec; StudioLiveFilterStack and live_filters composed. Allowed?
rulings.ruling: CHANGED: the entry is StudioLiveFilter with the effect key stored as `filter_kind` (not `effect_id`), plus `instance_id`, `enabled`, `version`, typed `params`. Holder StudioLiveFilterStack and member live_filters are allowed, listed as Studio-minted. Values of filter_kind are nib's effect ids; the converter maps filter_kind to EffectRecord::from_parts(effect_id, ..).
rulings.reason: READ spec :19395 (STU-FX-002): each StudioLiveFilter entry carries `filter_kind` (catalog key); :13038-13039 the registration record's filter_kind is 'used by StudioLiveFilter.filter_kind'; STU-FX-134 :18665 uses filter_kind for audio; folio already stores audio entries as filter_kind (folio/src/audio_preset.rs:58-62). A stored key is wire format; a rename later is a migration. The holder cannot be named StudioEffectStack: that name is taken in folio (raster.rs:740) and folio re-exports modules by glob.
rulings.red_team: Objection: nib's API says effect_id (live_effect.rs:617 from_parts(effect_id, ..)), so two names for one thing. Stands: nib is engine API, the document follows the spec; one converter (scope item 4) is the only place both names meet.

rulings.question: Q2 No composition token, since these are new inputs and every existing output is proven unchanged?

rulings.reason: READ spec :8096-8100: a token bump is required when shaping, breaking, justification or fallback semantics change. Stands: the token marks how one document was composed; a document that sets them was authored under this build. The reading goes to the spec owner as a proposal; the lead can overrule by adding a token later without a data migration.

replacement_scope.summary: Graphic EQ 10, 20 and 30 bands (spec tables) in Score, one filter-kind table that brings 14 existing and new processors into documents with their binding class stated, and noise reduction on a waveform selection with a stored print range; no new authored parameter list, DeEsser and Distortion raised as an SD item
replacement_scope.target:
All code facts below were re-read at cede5958. Paths are under `crates/`. Spec lines are module 14 v02.229. This replaces the 2026-11-07 scope: lead re-scope against STU-FX-128 and direction.blocker_decisions_20261107.scoped_lanes ('re-scoped against noise and multiband hosts').

**What changed and why.** STU-FX-128 (spec :13141-13150): a catalogue row with no parameter table is specified in identity and behaviour but not in parameters, and an implementer MUST raise the gap rather than invent a parameter list. DeEsser (:19057) and Distortion (:19062) have 0 parameters, so this lane authors no processor for them: both leave the lane and go to the spec owner as one SD item (below). The lane adds no new parameter list anywhere. It ships (a) the graphic EQ family, which has full parameter tables (STU-FX-136a :18727; GraphicEQ10Bands :18824, 20 :18844, 30 :18874); (b) document reach for processors Score already has, under their existing, already-validated parameter sets; (c) noise reduction on a waveform selection with a noise print, which needs no Folio schema change.

**The gap.** `harness-view/src/view/audio_batch.rs:43-55` `EffectSpec` has four kinds and `from_preset_instance` refuses every other `filter_kind` (`:819`, unknown filter_kind). Every document path goes through it: bus and master (`audio_session.rs:601-631` `bus_effect`), waveform effects (`waveform.rs:476-486`), batch and presets (`audio_batch.rs:509-529`), keyframe lookup (`timeline/audio.rs:383-392`). Pulse knows no processor kinds (`pulse/src/bus_mix.rs:15`). So Reverb, FeedbackDelay, Flanger, Chorus, Phaser, HardLimiter, HumRemover, ClickRepair, MultibandCompressor and NoiseReducer are tested in Score and reach no document (`git grep` of those names in harness-view, harness-core, harness, pulse, reel src at cede5958: 0 hits). Scenario audio-post steps 36, 37, 39, 40, 53, 61, 62 are engine_only for that reason (`workflows/scenario-audio-post.json`).

1. **Red first.** New `score/tests/graphic_eq.rs`, `score/tests/filter_kinds.rs`; `harness/tests/audio_filter_kinds.rs` starting `#![cfg(feature = "audio-batch")]` (round unit `["audio-batch"]`, `.config/round-features.toml:34`). Prove red by running. A pushed red commit must compile: give the new API refusing stubs first. Use `tests/common_dsp.rs` helpers.

2. **Graphic EQ kernel, new `score/src/graphic_eq.rs`.** Unchanged from the 2026-11-07 scope item 2 (Liski and Valimaki, DAFx-17; second-order peak sections in f64, transposed direct form II with the flush of `filters.rs:67-79`; `g_p` 17 dB; `c` 0.3 at 10 bands, 0.4 at 30, 20 bands swept 0.3..0.4 and pinned; bandwidth by bisection at construction, at most 60 steps; M = 2N - 1 design points, least squares, one iteration; band centres authored, dropped at or above 0.95 Nyquist as `restore.rs:601`; `active_bands()`). Do not change `Equalizer` (`eq.rs:17` MAX_EQ_SECTIONS 16). Proof as before: identity bit-exact at all-zero; worst band-centre error at most 1.0 dB at 44100 and 48000 Hz over all 1024 +-12 dB settings at 10 bands and all +12, all -12, zigzag and 200 seeded settings at 20 and 30 bands, with a stop rule (send the numbers, never loosen); stability at +-70 dB at 8000, 32000, 44100, 48000, 96000, 768000 Hz; block-partition and save_state/restore_state bit identity. Design at most once per `DESIGN_HOP` (default 256 frames, `layout.rs:18`), declared in docs and DESCRIPTOR; no allocation in process or design; design count test; measured design time debug and release.

3. **Parameter records, `score/src/spec_rows.rs`.** As scope item 3: a typed record with Option fields for hard_min, hard_max, soft_min, soft_max, default, normalised default, unit, precision, slot and mapping (STU-FX-136b :18732, STU-FX-107 :12839, STU-FX-121 :12998); const tables for the three sheets row for row; `from_normalised` on the pattern of `HardLimiterParams::from_normalised` (`dsp.rs:337`); add rows to `SPEC_ROWS` (`spec_rows.rs:40`): `gain` and `amp*` bound, `accuracy` and `range` `Err(NO_MEANING)`, accepted, range checked, stored, no effect on sound. `tests/multiband.rs:221` walks every row.

4. **Filter-kind table in Score, new `score/src/filter_kinds.rs`.** No Folio edge. Rows: `filter_kind`, binding class, catalogue identity and import key only where the row has a parameter table, parameters (key, default, score automation index or none). `build_audio_filter(filter_kind, params: &[(&str, f64)], rate, channels) -> Result<Box<dyn Automatable + Send>, AudioFilterError>`, a typed error with `code()` like `SpecRowError` (`spec_rows.rs:18-33`); no new `ScoreError` variants.

| filter_kind | Builds | Binding class | Catalogue row claimed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `graphic_eq_10_bands`, `_20_`, `_30_` | item 2 | `spec_table` | GraphicEQ10/20/30Bands, import keys `AudioFilter:GraphicEQ10Bands` etc. |
| `hard_limiter` | `dsp.rs:316` | `spec_table` (sheet mapped by `from_normalised`) | Hard Limiter |
| `flanger`, `phaser` | `modulation.rs:166`, `:414` | `spec_table_partial` (bound rows in SPEC_ROWS, rest Undeclared) | Flanger, Phaser |
| `chorus`, `click_repair` | `modulation.rs:289`, `restore.rs:81` | `authored_on_tabled_row` (every sheet row Undeclared in SPEC_ROWS) | none claimed |
| `reverb`, `feedback_delay`, `hum_remover`, `multiband_compressor` | `reverb.rs:39`, `delay.rs:48`, `restore.rs:555`, `multiband.rs:186` | `authored_existing` (Score's own validated set; no table or no binding) | none claimed |

Every row's parameter list is the existing Score params struct, field for field; the lane writes none. `multiband_compressor` stores `bands` (whole number 2..=4), `crossover_<i>_hz` for i < bands-1, and per band the `DynamicsParams` fields as `band_<i>_<field>` (the equalizer's `section_<i>_*` form, `audio_batch.rs:694-697` for enumerations and booleans). Whole-number fields (`bands`, `voices`, `stages`, `harmonics`, `ar_order`, enumerations) are checked before any cast (`pick`, `audio_batch.rs:689`): 1e308, -1, 2.5 and NaN refuse. Tests: every row builds at its defaults mono and stereo where the kind allows; the table's automation keys equal `automation_parameters()` names in order; each kind joins `tests/automation.rs:48` `kinds()` (update the pin at `:226`, 59 today; READ count not re-run); identity prefix equals `filter_kind`; defaults inside range; a test asserts that no row claims an import key unless its binding class is `spec_table` or `spec_table_partial`. Mention the table and the binding classes in `DESCRIPTOR` (`lib.rs:156`).

5. **Document reach, harness-view.** `view/audio_batch.rs`: one `EffectSpec` variant holding `filter_kind` and params, delegating to item 4 in `build` (`:58`), `build_automatable` (`:71`), `automation_index` (`:87`), `to_preset_instance` (`:698`) and `from_preset_instance` (`:751`). Keep the four existing kinds and their stored records byte for byte; refusals stay `preset_effect`. `view/mixer.rs:106-120` `effect_templates` gains the 14 kinds (the panel draws what it returns, `mixer.rs:877`).
